p.i: illo destituar Honoris & Majestatis portione di-gna Loco in quo me collocasti, qui es Exaltator Capitis mei & Salus mea.
Duc me Domine tuâ Gratiâ ad eam veram solum & æternam Gloriam.

main_text.head: 22. Cum abiret Rex ab Oxonio & se ad Sco-tos reciperet.
main_text.p: QVanquàm tria mihi Regna Deus dederit, nullibi tamen locus restat, ubi jam tutum caput ( tuto simul Honore ) deponam. Ita enim ostendere volebat Deus se tutissimum esse perfugium, & arcem omnium munitissimam in qua oportet con-fidere.

In his rerum angustiis non tam Homines quàm Deum respicio. Sic Illi visum est facere: atque adeò Me penitus & afflictas res meas in Illius misericordiam conjicio, cujus unius arbitrio manus omnium & corda imperantur.
Quod viribus negat providentia, prudentiæ forsan

page.notes: The page has no marginal notes and no catchword or signature. Drop-cap "Q" in "QVanquàm" is a large woodcut-style initial, transcribed joined to the word. The "Quod" line ends the scan; the continuation "forsan" is printed at the start of the next line and is kept as printed. Doubtful: "tuto simul" and "solum" read as printed; no [?] needed. Greek running head "EIKΩN BASIAIKH." is transcribed as printed with Greek letters in the Latin running head, as the printer set it.
